title.th: การแต่งตั้งรองนายทะเบียน

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Registration of Births and Deaths Act
(Chapter 267)
Appointment of Deputy Registrars
It is hereby notified for general information that, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 3(2) of the Registration of Births and Deaths Act, the Minister for Home Affairs has appointed the following officers to be Deputy Registrars of Births and Deaths for the purposes of the Act, with effect from 25th July 2001:
(1)Commanding Officer, Bishan Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(2)Commanding Officer, Bukit Merah East Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(3)Commanding Officer, Bukit Timah Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(4)Commanding Officer, Kampong Java Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(5)Commanding Officer, Orchard Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(6)Commanding Officer, Rochor Neighbourhood Police Centre.
(7)Commanding Officer, Toa Payoh Neighbourhood Police Centre.
